设计意图： This mutation changes the event-definition axis from a traded-high boundary to a settlement-high boundary. The parent defined the broken range as the previous 20-day high, so a single extreme wick could define the boundary and the retest-defense event could be triggered by noise. The child defines the boundary as the previous 20-day close high, so only a genuine closing-price breakout establishes

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 boundary：close.滚动窗口(20).max().shift(1)
  2. 计算 recent_breakout：(close > boundary).astype(float).滚动窗口(10).max().shift(1)
  3. 计算 retest_defense：((low <= boundary) & (close > boundary)).astype(float)
  4. 计算 penetration：(boundary - low).clip(lower=0.0)
  5. 计算 recovery：(close - boundary).clip(lower=0.0)
  6. 计算 recovery_ratio：recovery / (penetration + recovery)
  7. 计算 close_loc：alpha_tools.intraday_close_location(df_copy)
  8. 计算 vol_ma：volume.滚动窗口(20).mean()
  9. 计算 vol_ratio：volume / vol_ma
  10. 计算 narrow_bar：1.0 / (1.0 + (high - low) / close)
  11. 计算 participation：(1.0 / (1.0 + vol_ratio)) * narrow_bar

🔍 公式逐行拆解（算子释义）

  1. MA20(V) — MA20(x) → 20 期移动均线
  2. rolling(20) — rolling(n) → 滚动窗口
  3. max(close) — max(x, n) → 滚动最大 / 逐点最大
  4. shift(1) — shift(n) → 滞后/移位

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_defended_close_high_retest_participation_20_5(df): """Idea: After a recent breakout to a new 20-day closing high, a retest that pierces the old close-based boundary but closes back above it, with shrinking volume ">class="kw">and narrow bars, confirms a durable level hold. Logic: Boundary is the previous 20-day close high, so wick-only breakouts are ignored. A retest-defense bar is low <= boundary "kw">class="kw">and close > boundary. The score combines the same-bar recovery ratio, intraday close location, "kw">class="kw">and participation quality (volume contraction "kw">class="kw">and narrow daily range), then averages over 5 days so repeated defended retests accumulate. Formula: S = mean_5( I[recent breakout] * I[low<=B & close>B] * ((close-B)/((B-low)+(close-B))) * close_loc * (1/(1+V/MA20(V))) * (1/(1+(H-L)/close)) ), B=rolling(20).max(close).shift(1) Sub-mechanism tags: close_level_boundary, retest_defense, volume_contraction, breakout_continuation """ df_copy = df.copy() boundary = df_copy["close"].rolling(20).max().shift(1) recent_breakout = (df_copy["close"] > boundary).astype(float).rolling(10).max().shift(1) retest_defense = ((df_copy["low"] <= boundary) & (df_copy["close"] > boundary)).astype(float) penetration = (boundary - df_copy["low"]).clip(lower=0.0) recovery = (df_copy["close"] - boundary).clip(lower=0.0) recovery_ratio = recovery / (penetration + recovery).replace(0.0, np.nan) close_loc = alpha_tools.intraday_close_location(df_copy) vol_ma = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan) vol_ratio = df_copy["volume"] / vol_ma narrow_bar = 1.0 / (1.0 + (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]) / df_copy["close"]) participation = (1.0 / (1.0 + vol_ratio)) * narrow_bar score = np.where( (recent_breakout > 0) & (retest_defense > 0), recovery_ratio.fillna(0.0) * close_loc * participation, 0.0, ) df_copy["factor_defended_close_high_retest_participation_20_5"] = pd.Series(score, index=df_copy.index).rolling(5, min_periods=1).mean() "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_defended_close_high_retest_participation_20_5"]
